title: The LLM Wears Prada: Analysing Gender Bias and Stereotypes through Online Shopping Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM predictions of a user's gender based on historical online shopping purchase lists by analyzing the odds ratios of product-gender co-occurrences. The study also measures bias by comparing product recommendations generated for users with different assumed genders (male vs. female) and calculating the Jaccard Similarity to determine recommendation overlap.
